403 Forbidden means the server understood your request perfectly but refused to authorize it.
Unlike 401 Unauthorized, this isn’t about missing authentication—it’s about being rejected despite the server knowing exactly what you want.
Think of it like reaching a club door: the bouncer sees you’re a person but still refuses entry based on other factors.
